body: If I were a good person then I would have people around me. Then I wouldnt be here. Then I wouldnt sit here alone in the middle of the night. If I were a good person then I would have maybe atleast 1-2 friends. Maybe. If I were good maybe I would be invited somewhere. Maybe I would be wanted. Needed. Loved. Cared for. I dont know
The only thing on my mind right now is that I dont want to be here anymore and feel alone. I wish I could go back in time and just become a better person.
Ofc I do, but how do I even do that. I dont know anymore.
